# Rate Sheet — Fixture Lanes (2026)

Effective date: 04/01/2026

This Rate Sheet applies to all shipments moved by Ridgeline Freight, LLC.

| Lane | Origin | Destination | Miles | Rate per Mile |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lane-chi-mke | Chicago, IL | Milwaukee, WI | 92 | $3.10 |

## Accessorial Charges

| Service | Unit | Charge |

## Notes

1. Payment for accessorial charges follows Net 15.
